text_block_list.text:
One holiday afternoon. As I looked around 
for a seat to eat lunch……

A notebook that caught my attention had 
fallen under the seat.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aha! I found it, desu! 'El's World's 
Strongest Notebook No. 4'!!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodneeeess~! I couldn't find it 
anywhere!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aha, so it was here all along~! It must've 
happened when I ate that super spicy 
toasted sandwich...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno! Much thanks for picking it up! I 
cannot thank you enough!
choice_data_list:
That notebook must be really special to 
you.

That notebook is really important to you, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Back during his active days, Papa 
used to write down new pro wrestling moves 
in a notebook just like this!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In other words! In that notebook, El wrote 
down all the running tips she discovered 
so far, along with super-secret info—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! To thank you for picking it up, 
I'll share one piece of info from my 
notebook with you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
My top recommendations are the "El-Style 
Power Workout Menu" and "Tips for Running 
in Sunny Races"! So, which will it be!?
choice_data_list: Tips for racing on a sunny day

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understooooood! This'll definitely make 
you super powerful, no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, lend me your ears! This is 
El's top secret, so keep it between us!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Clear skies, bold attacks, total 
surprise! You've got quite an eye to pick 
that one!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, lend me your ears! This is 
El's top secret, so keep it between us!
